text:
Anna Li: FYI - bringing bronte9b-int4 into canary pool. initial smoke shows intermittent OOMs that look like fragmentation, not a leak. batch_size=8, max_new_tokens=256 reproduces reliably on 3 hosts.
Sam Ortiz: can you paste the exact curl you used?
Anna Li: repro: ```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"bronte9b-int4","inputs":"summarize: ...","max_new_tokens":256,"batch_size":8}'
```
Anna Li: log snip: "allocate_slab failed: requested 48MB, largest_contig 10MB, free_chunks 120"
Jia Chen: yep classic slab fragmentation. two quick levers: reduce max_new_tokens default to 128; enable soft slot compaction between requests (slot_compact=true) for canary.
Miguel Rivera: from pavo11b playbook, microbatching helps: batch_size=4 w/ kv_prefetch=false reduced fragmentation spikes. Could try that too.
Sam Ortiz: what's the perf tradeoff if we drop to batch_size 4 and 128 max tokens?
Anna Li: ran a short A/B: batch=4 + max_new_tokens=128 + slot_compact=true + kv_prefetch=false => OOMs 37/day -> 2/day. p50 latency +5ms, p95 +22ms, throughput -9%. still within SLOs.
ops-bot: deploy-canary bronte9b-int4 cfg=slotcompact-v1 by anna-li succeeded on 5/8 hosts :white_check_mark:
Sam Ortiz: good. rollout plan?
Anna Li: propose staged: 10% now, monitor 2h; if OOMs <5 move to 30%; monitor 6h; full after 24h. I'll open RED-3421 with logs and perf charts.
Jia Chen: add alert: slab_fragmentation_ratio > 0.7 for 5m per-host, and slab_free_ratio < 0.2 for 5m. include per-host histograms to avoid noisy global alerts.
Miguel Rivera: I'll add a tiny reproducer script to scripts/onboard/bronze-smoke.sh and push WIP. includes pinned RNG seed and a steady token stream.
Anna Li: thanks — I'll PR the config, include the benchmark, and add rollback instructions. tagging @infra for kernel slab metrics access on RED-3421.
Sam Ortiz: +1. once PR lands I'll coordinate with support for the rollout window.
Jia Chen: long-term we should consider an adaptive compact-on-evict heuristic in the runtime: run compaction when fragmentation crosses threshold and recent OOMs > 0. filing RFC after stabilization.
Anna Li: agreed. i'll file RFC after rollout. will post PR and short postmortem if anything pops.
